body.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: completed BODY attachment for an existing 2D cutout game character, actual animation source artwork. Input 1 is the approved full cute ochre pebble creature (design authority). Input 2 is its current separated body attachment with incomplete cut-outs and remnants around the two foot sockets. Draw the SAME body alone, WITHOUT either foot or foot fragments. Preserve the wide rounded asymmetric pebble silhouette, both exact dark round eyes, original eye spacing and expression, ochre sandstone facets, lighting, dark fine green-black outline, hand-painted game-sprite finish, original proportions and front view. Complete the entire lower body as one continuous clean closed curved stone contour. Fill every rectangular missing region and foot-shaped bite around the lower edge. Remove all gold foot remnants from the body. Paint the normally hidden underside in the same darker ochre stone material, smoothly continuing the existing lower-body shading and outline. The underside must be complete even when the feet move away; no flat crop edges, holes, cutout bites, transparent gaps or dangling partial outlines. Do not add legs, new features, cracks, accessories, mouth, eyebrows, extra eyes, floor or cast shadow. Genuine transparent background. One complete body attachment only, centered with generous transparent margins; no layout, labels or text. This is a hidden-contour repair: the original body front pixels will be preserved outside the two tiny foot-contact repair regions when this source is integrated.

foot.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: one COMPLETE foot-pad attachment for an existing 2D cutout pebble creature. Input 1 is a small original warm ochre stone foot pad whose TOP has been CUT OFF by a horizontal crop; input 2 is the approved original creature for style and material. Reconstruct only the tiny foot as a COMPLETE smooth closed flattened rounded pebble, including the missing rounded upper/back half normally hidden beneath the body. The complete foot should be a squat horizontal oval, approximately 2:1 width-to-height. Preserve the existing lower-front warm ochre shading, dark fine green-black outline, softly faceted sandstone material and original hand-painted game-sprite finish. Smooth continuous closed silhouette all around, no flat horizontal top, no cut-off rectangles, no bites or transparent holes in the stone. Soft upper-left lighting, slightly darker lower rim. One foot pad only, no body, face, eyes, toes, leg, ankle, accessories, ground or cast shadow. Genuine transparent background, foot centered with generous margins, no text or labels. This is actual source artwork used only to complete the hidden upper contour; the original visible lower-foot pixels will be retained during integration.
